infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SympLens uses the camera so you can photograph a symptom. Photos are only sent for analysis when you tap Analyze.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo to analyze. It is only sent when you tap Analyze.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used for voice input when you choose to dictate a description.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Used to turn your voice into text when you choose to dictate.
